visibility_contract.note: Declared 40 m abstract island plateau, not surveyed elevation. Sensor circles are upper envelopes, not guaranteed coverage.

ingress_contract.meaning: Initial positions are declared in scenario.yaml. No claim of guaranteed sensor exclusion or off-map travel is made; normal visibility rules apply.
ingress_contract.visibility: No hidden flag or grace period. Once native sensors can detect an approaching entity, normal scoped contacts apply.
ingress_contract.reinforcement_validation: Ten blue units present at tick 0; no subsequent spawn events.
ingress_contract.position_validation: Coordinates match scenario.yaml. Nominal clearance is measured against INITIAL defender positions only; it does not certify visibility after either side moves.
